items.title: TinyFish Breaks Down Agentic Search Architecture for Production AI Agents
items.summary: TinyFish published two engineering research articles on agentic search. One defines a 7-phase production architecture with evidence contracts and bounded retries. The other explains why its deep research system dropped a separate planner and per-query subagents. The post TinyFish Breaks Down Agentic Search Architecture for Production AI Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Google Cloud Launches Agent Compute Engine: A MicroVM per AI Agent
items.summary: Google Cloud announced Agent Compute Engine, a compute service that gives every AI agent its own hardware-isolated microVM with no credentials inside. It already runs Gemini agents and enters preview in the coming months. The post Google Cloud Launches Agent Compute Engine: A MicroVM per AI Agent appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: You.com Launches Inference Router: 12 Open-Weight Models With 99.9% Uptime SLA
items.summary: You.com launched Inference Router, an OpenAI-compatible API for 12 open-weight models with a 99.9% uptime SLA, zero data retention, 100% US hosting, server-side web search and no platform fee. The post You.com Launches Inference Router: 12 Open-Weight Models With 99.9% Uptime SLA appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Liquid AI Launches RIPL, a Real-Time Inference Engine for Sub-50 ms LFMs
items.summary: Liquid AI released RIPL, a real-time inference engine for its LFM models. On one B200, LFM2.5-1.2B on RIPL showed 14.4 to 28.4x lower p95 latency than Qwen3.5-0.8B on vLLM. The post Liquid AI Launches RIPL, a Real-Time Inference Engine for Sub-50 ms LFMs appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Gradium Open-Sources Phonon, a 31M-Parameter On-Device TTS Model Under Apache 2.0
items.summary: Gradium has open-sourced Phonon, a family of on-device text-to-speech models. The English Phonon 31m ships under Apache 2.0, fits in 64.5 MB, and starts speaking in about 7 ms on a laptop CPU. The post Gradium Open-Sources Phonon, a 31M-Parameter On-Device TTS Model Under Apache 2.0 appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Cohere Releases Rerank 5 With Passage-Level Context Focus and Calibrated Scores
items.summary: Cohere Rerank 5 ships in Pro and Fast tiers with a 32K context window, Context Focus passage extraction and calibrated relevance scores. Pro scores 82.2 on BRIGHT and costs $0.05 per 1M tokens. The post Cohere Releases Rerank 5 With Passage-Level Context Focus and Calibrated Scores appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: A Developer’s Guide to OmniParseBench: Leaderboard Benchmarks and OCR Testing
items.summary: Explore how to audit and rebuild Datalab's OmniParseBench, test parser ranking certainty with document-level bootstrapping, and evaluate Tesseract and Indra OCR performance on a custom sample. The post A Developer’s Guide to OmniParseBench: Leaderboard Benchmarks and OCR Testing appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: IBM AI Releases Granite Speech 5.0 2B for Multilingual Transcription and Translation
items.summary: IBM released Granite Speech 5.0 2B, an Apache 2.0 speech recognition and translation model. It ranks #2 on the Open ASR Leaderboard with 5.68% average English WER, alongside updated Turbo CTC and 4.1 2B Plus models. The post IBM AI Releases Granite Speech 5.0 2B for Multilingual Transcription and Translation appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Perplexity and NVIDIA Researchers Introduce JOLT: a Joint Teacher-Student Reinforcement Learning Method
items.summary: Perplexity and NVIDIA introduced JOLT, a post-training method that trains one model as both teacher and student. On MATH it matched GRPO’s accuracy with 6.5x fewer processed training tokens. The post Perplexity and NVIDIA Researchers Introduce JOLT: a Joint Teacher-Student Reinforcement Learning Method appeared first on MarkTechPost.
